title: profile-retirement-policy-and-autosunset-annotator
author: Priya Khanna
description:
Motivation: Over time model profiles accumulate (old variants, un-requested quantizations, and deprecated adapters) which add noise to onboarding, inflate the registry, and complicate customer-facing release notes. This PR implements a policy-driven "profile retirement" mechanism plus an Autosunset Annotator that generates concise, context-aware changelog/snippet entries recommending replacements or migration steps.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a retirement policy engine that evaluates profile age, last-serving-date (from telemetry), sample-coverage, and stability-signature to produce a retirement score.
- Introduces an Autosunset Annotator that composes changelog blurbs (short/medium length) and optional migration hints (CLI flags, model alias mappings) when a profile is marked for retirement.
- Exposes a /profiles/retire dry-run and apply endpoints in the registry API; and a CLI command (models retire --dry-run --threshold) for batch operations.
- Emits audit entries and a release note fragment that can be consumed by the onboard release assembler to include sunset notices in release manifests.
- Adds safety gates: staged retirement (notify-only), required human acknowledgement for >50% coverage change, and automatic rollback hooks for churn spikes.

Why it's built this way:
- We want deterministic, explainable retirements (no black-box purges). The policy engine is rules-first with pluggable heuristics so we can tune for enterprise vs. PLG usage.
- The Autosunset output is intentionally terse and structured (a small template library) so downstream consumers (docs, release notes, SDKs) can render human-friendly text or machine-readable migration hints.

Checklist (this PR):
- [x] Policy engine implementation + unit tests
- [x] Autosunset annotator + templating and generator tests
- [x] API surface + CLI entrypoint + integration tests
- [x] Audit logging + event ping to telemetry pipeline
- [x] Documentation draft (registry/retirement.md) + example release note snippet
- [x] E2E staging run validating no accidental retirements on current catalog

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- Retirement scoring defaults to off for existing customers; config flag `retirement.enabled=false` preserves current behavior.
- The API adds optional query params and a new /profiles/retire route; clients using the registry should remain unaffected unless they call the new endpoints.

Rollout plan:
- Merge behind feature flag, run staged retirements on a small cohort, manual review of generated autosunset entries for 2 weeks, then opt-in program for customers to enable automated retirements.

Related work items: Linear ENG-4523, PM-98. Support ticket SUP-217: customer requested clearer notice for deprecated variants.

Notes on uniqueness: This focuses on the retirement lifecycle and auto-generation of sunset blurb content (not just changelog concatenation). The annotator produces a short sentence, optional replacement mapping, and a migration snippet suitable for release notes and SDK upgrade guides.
